mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a structure-property rationale for derived peptide activity: C-terminal β-defensin fragments were modeled, Cys-to-Ser substitutions were used in design, and Trp insertion/basic charge are discussed as improving antibacterial interaction profiles.

mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization or target-binding assay is reported for these peptides in the local paper; mechanism remains inferred from molecular modeling, activity tables, and literature-grounded discussion.
